events.continuity_hook: Follows the Minneapolis conference booking refinement with a practical pre-trip timing check.
events.interaction_goal: Reset the Sunday arrival timeline, choose carry-on versus checked-bag assumptions, map airport-to-hotel transit, plan luggage storage before registration, confirm breakfast and dinner logistics, and protect the Wednesday airport window.
events.scenario_brief: The Minneapolis conference reservations are in place, but the conference app adds a Sunday badge-pickup window and the airline nudges Tessa's outbound slightly later. Her hotel will hold bags but will not promise early check-in, and the Tuesday alumni dinner is now several blocks from the conference venue. The plan needs a final pass so the first afternoon is not too tight and Wednesday's return after the noon workshop still works cleanly.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new short work-trip episode after the conference travel is finished.
events.interaction_goal: Compare drive versus fly-and-rent options, outline the Twin Falls to Nampa to Boise timing, shortlist practical hotel areas, note parking and road-work risks, and identify breakfast and late-dinner backups.
events.scenario_brief: After the Minneapolis conference, Tessa gets asked to add a compact Idaho trip: a Monday late-afternoon counselor coffee in Twin Falls, a Tuesday morning breakfast near Nampa, and a Tuesday evening admitted-family meetup in downtown Boise. Flying into Boise would be predictable but creates backtracking, while driving from Salt Lake City fits the route but adds a long Monday. The unresolved pieces are travel mode, whether to use one Boise-area hotel or split the overnight, and how to keep meals easy around the early and late events.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Idaho mini-loop after event times and venue details change.
events.interaction_goal: Rank the one-night and two-night hotel plans, choose the likely overnight area, set a realistic Tuesday return or Wednesday morning return, compare parking costs, and pick simple breakfast and dinner plans around the event schedule.
events.scenario_brief: The Idaho hosts send updates before Tessa books: the Nampa breakfast arrival time moves earlier, the Boise meetup ends later than expected, and the Twin Falls venue confirms easy parking. The Boise-area hotel with the best breakfast setup is refundable but farther from Tuesday night's event, while a downtown option is better for dinner but has paid parking. She needs to decide whether avoiding a late Tuesday drive back to Salt Lake City is worth an extra hotel night.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Idaho work trip from comparison into final reservations and a near-term timing pass.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the hotel choice, confirm the room and parking details, build the Monday-through-Wednesday driving timeline, list meal backups, note receipt needs, and plan luggage and materials handling between Nampa and Boise.
events.scenario_brief: Tessa has settled on driving the Idaho loop and is ready to lock in the hotel plan. She is leaning toward Monday night in Meridian with a Wednesday-morning return from Boise to avoid a late-night drive after the admitted-family meetup. The remaining details are room setup, cancellation timing, reimbursable mileage and parking notes, breakfast hours, and where to keep recruitment materials secure during the Tuesday stops.

events.continuity_hook: Shifts from spring work travel to a short family weekend using the same practical flight and hotel planning style.
events.interaction_goal: Compare Friday evening and Saturday morning flight options against driving, shortlist hotel areas near the graduation and relatives, check two-queen availability, note breakfast and nearby restaurants, and decide what to hold while family plans firm up.
events.scenario_brief: After the Idaho trip, Tessa starts a late-May family weekend for a niece's graduation near Sacramento. She, her spouse, and one teenager can leave after school and work on Friday, attend the Saturday afternoon ceremony, join a Sunday brunch with relatives, and return Monday. Driving would be a long holiday-weekend push, while flying into Sacramento and renting a car is easier but needs a family-friendly schedule and a two-queen hotel room.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Sacramento family weekend after school timing and hotel availability change.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the flight or drive plan, compare the late Friday connection with Saturday nonstop timing, finalize the rental-car need, pick a refundable hotel with the right bedding, confirm breakfast and dinner options, and note seat and receipt details for booking.
events.scenario_brief: The graduation weekend details firm up, but the teenager's Friday exam release is later than expected and the most affordable Friday flight now involves a connection that arrives close to midnight. A Saturday nonstop would be easier but would miss part of the family lunch, and the closest hotels have shifted to prepaid rooms. Tessa needs to decide how much inconvenience is worth avoiding the long drive and whether a refundable hotel farther out is the safer pick.
